answer: The ripple register is checked at draw time, fable lists the eligible set, and quill seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 86 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker forfeits for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 86 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. That is 9 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
